input: Planets placed in Ashwini nakshatra blend Mars and Ketu energy, since it lies in Aries and is ruled by Ketu.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Planets in Ashwini nakshatra bring dynamism, tenacity, fierce activity and a strong appetite for life.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Ashwini nakshatra is a light, swift (laghu) star and its main motivation is dharma (duty, law, ethics).
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Ashwini nakshatra is good for the Moon to occupy when beginning a journey.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Ashwini nakshatra gives the power to heal quickly and is favourable for giving medicine and doing healing work.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Afflicted planets in Ashwini nakshatra can bring passion, lust and poor discretion.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Venus placed in Ashwini nakshatra may bring sexual difficulties.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Saturn placed in Ashwini nakshatra may bring dissatisfaction, disappointment, mental unrest and fear of criticism.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Shadow side of Ashwini nakshatra is impulsiveness, aggression, stubbornness and arrogance.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Ascendant in Ashwini nakshatra
outcome: adventurous, loves travel, bright eyes and magnetic look.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Ascendant in Ashwini nakshatra
outcome: respected, prominent, modest and efficient, but needs to control diet and may face drug problems.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Moon in Ashwini nakshatra
outcome: intelligent bright mind, attractive appearance, happy mood and gives hope to others.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Moon in Ashwini nakshatra
outcome: healing gifts, nurturing nature, love of music, fine arts and travel, belief in God and sincere family love.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Moon in Ashwini nakshatra
outcome: marriage usually between ages 26 and 30, and struggle until about age 30 after which progress comes.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Sun in Ashwini nakshatra (exalted in Aries)
outcome: regal proud nature, business skill, desire for leadership, authority, power and fame, possibly militant.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Ashwini nakshatra career indications
outcome: psychologist, therapist, physician, healer, mystic, military, police, merchant, salesperson, musician, horse trainer.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Ashwini nakshatra health indications
outcome: head injuries, headaches, mental illness, smallpox and malaria.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashwini

input: Planets in Bharani nakshatra combine Mars (Aries) and Venus (nakshatra ruler), giving creative potential.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Bharani

input: Sun placed in Bharani nakshatra (Sun exalted in Aries) confers leadership, authority and power.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Bharani

input: Bharani nakshatra is a fierce (krura) star linked with imprisonment and confinement, and its main motivation is artha (wealth).
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Bharani

input: Bharani nakshatra gives power to cleanse and remove impurities and suits yogic disciplines like breath control and meditation.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Bharani

input: Austerities may be needed to harness the creative force of Bharani nakshatra.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Bharani

input: Shadow side of Bharani nakshatra
outcome: struggle, suffering, restlessness, irritability, impatience, moralistic and judgmental attitude, pride, vanity, sexual indulgence.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Bharani

input: Ascendant in Bharani nakshatra
outcome: courageous pioneering spirit, pride, confidence, fame and vibrant health.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Bharani

input: Ascendant in Bharani nakshatra
outcome: eager to help friends and family, fond of family but may have few biological children.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Bharani

input: Moon in Bharani nakshatra
outcome: attractive charismatic personality, leadership in public life, vitality and freedom from disease.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Bharani

input: Moon in Bharani nakshatra
outcome: clever and dutiful at work, interest in the occult, success in writing and publishing, general improvement after age 33.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Bharani

input: Sun in Bharani nakshatra
outcome: intelligent, tactful, earns fame, respect and wealth, creative, but anger, pride and a militant streak are possible.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Bharani

input: Bharani nakshatra career indications
outcome: publisher, writer, film and music worker, occultist, astrologer, psychologist, entrepreneur, financial consultant, lawyer, building contractor.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Bharani

input: Bharani nakshatra health indications
outcome: reproductive organ problems, venereal disease, face and eyesight problems, head injuries.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Bharani

input: Krittika nakshatra is ruled by the Sun; its first pada falls in Aries and the remaining three padas in Taurus.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Krittika

input: Planets in the first pada of Krittika (Aries part) get a Sun-Mars dynamic giving leadership, authority and power.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Krittika

input: Planets in the Taurus part of Krittika get a Venus-Sun influence giving gifts in the fine arts.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Krittika

input: Krittika nakshatra is mixed (misra) in nature, good for daily tasks such as cooking, and its main motivation is kama (desire).
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Krittika

input: Krittika nakshatra has power to burn away or cut through negativity, and a fire ceremony honouring Agni is recommended.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Krittika

input: Shadow side of Krittika nakshatra
outcome: stubborn, aggressive, destructive, angry, passive-aggressive, illicit affairs and attraction to others' partners.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Krittika

input: Krittika nakshatra natives may have trouble with diet and eating habits, and must discipline desire and seek healing pleasures.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Krittika

input: Ascendant in Krittika nakshatra
outcome: dignified, proud, honourable, ambitious, skilful, wealthy, truthful, with a strong appetite and at times a wavering mind.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Krittika

input: Moon in Krittika nakshatra
outcome: brilliant appearance, peaceful and well known, a good advisor with strong determination, though the mind may be unstable.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Krittika

input: Moon in Krittika nakshatra
outcome: gifts in fine arts, tendency to live away from birthplace, attached to mother, possible trouble with father, good periods at ages 25-35 and 50-56.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Krittika

input: Sun in Krittika nakshatra
outcome: disciplined spiritual warrior, leadership and power over masses, trouble with authority figures, need for solitude, gifts in music, dance and drama, possible angry temper.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Krittika

input: Krittika nakshatra career indications
outcome: spiritual teacher, advisor, musician, dancer, singer, model, fashion designer, military, building contractor.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Krittika

input: Krittika nakshatra health indications
outcome: neck ache, sore throat, headaches, fevers, malaria.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Krittika

input: Rohini nakshatra lies in Taurus, ruled by the Moon (in its mulatrikona sign) with Venus ruling the sign, giving a creative Moon-Venus combination.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Rohini

input: Rohini nakshatra gives beauty, sensuality, charisma and charm, and tremendous creativity and fine-arts gifts to planets placed there.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Rohini

input: Rohini nakshatra is rajasic, calls for travel and movement, gives prominence and influence in society, and its main motivation is moksha.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Rohini

input: Rohini nakshatra has the power of growth, creation and fertility.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Rohini

input: Shadow side of Rohini nakshatra
outcome: indulgence, materialism, luxury-seeking, obstinacy, short temper, critical nature, jealousy and possessiveness.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Rohini

input: Ascendant in Rohini nakshatra
outcome: brilliant, attractive, magnetic eyes, charismatic leader possibly wealthy with political power or popularity.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Rohini

input: Ascendant in Rohini nakshatra
outcome: virile, romantic, artistic and sensual, with risk of indulgence and sexual addiction.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Rohini

input: Moon in Rohini nakshatra
outcome: lovely appearance, balanced mind, gifts in music, dance and drama, successful career affecting the public, success in politics, fame and wealth.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Rohini

input: Moon in Rohini nakshatra
outcome: good health and well-developed muscles, best periods ages 30-50 after the Rahu dasha, early marriage may be troubled and the person may be indecisive.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Rohini

input: Sun in Rohini nakshatra
outcome: beautiful seductive sensual person, artistic with strong emotions, poetic and musical gifts, robust and well liked with many friends.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Rohini

input: Rohini nakshatra career indications
outcome: politician, musician, artist, actor, dancer, agriculture, real estate, restaurant and hotel business, fashion.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Rohini

input: Rohini nakshatra health indications
outcome: colds and cough, irregular menses, sunstroke, obesity, sore throat, venereal disease.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Rohini

input: Mrigashira nakshatra is ruled by Mars, is god-like (devic), and its main motivation is moksha; it makes a spiritual warrior searching for truth.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Mrigashira

input: Mrigashira nakshatra has the power of giving fulfilment.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Mrigashira

input: Planets in the Taurus half of Mrigashira nakshatra help ideas take material form, give poetic and musical talent and material affluence.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Mrigashira

input: Taurus half of Mrigashira nakshatra is good for producing beautiful, creative and intelligent children.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Mrigashira

input: Planets in the Gemini half of Mrigashira nakshatra support writing, public speaking, persuasion, curiosity and research.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Mrigashira

input: Mrigashira nakshatra is soft and tender (mridu), giving a gentle, sensitive nature that may fear confrontation.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Mrigashira

input: Birth and marriage are considered auspicious under Mrigashira nakshatra.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Mrigashira

input: Shadow side of Mrigashira nakshatra
outcome: indulgence in pleasure, sensory attachment and a fickle nature, especially in the Gemini half.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Mrigashira

input: Ascendant in Mrigashira nakshatra
outcome: attractive, seductive, mystical truth seeker, enthusiastic, talkative, daring, fond of travel, with a vacillating mind.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Mrigashira

input: Moon in Mrigashira nakshatra
outcome: intelligence, writing skill, political nature and wealth, sensual but timid, possible trouble in business partnerships.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Mrigashira

input: Moon in Mrigashira nakshatra
outcome: life generally improves once the Rahu dasa begins around age 21.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Mrigashira

input: Sun in Mrigashira nakshatra
outcome: adventurous, courageous, athletic, competitive, leadership, poetic writing and creativity, but possible indulgence and laziness.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Mrigashira

input: Mrigashira nakshatra career indications
outcome: writer, poet, astrologer, mystic, researcher, teacher, engineer, gemologist, actor, musician, real estate, sales, travel agent.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Mrigashira

input: Mrigashira nakshatra health indications
outcome: vocal cords, sore throat, constipation, venereal disease, sciatica.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Mrigashira

input: Ardra nakshatra is ruled by Rahu with Mercury's rulership of Gemini prominent, blending deep feeling with passionate thinking.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ardra

input: Ardra nakshatra has themes of death, pain and suffering, with Rudra as deity.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ardra

input: Moon in Ardra nakshatra means birth in the Rahu dasa, described as turbulent.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ardra

input: Ardra nakshatra's main motivation is kama; it brings fierce activity, enthusiasm and urge for expansion.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ardra

input: Ardra nakshatra is sharp (tikshna) and produces bold, brash, powerful activities.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ardra

input: Ardra nakshatra's power is effort; gains come through persistence and some luck.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ardra

input: Shadow side of Ardra nakshatra
outcome: abuse of power, material greed, causing pain to others, pride, violence, criticism, complaining and ingratitude.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ardra

input: Ardra natives may work in helping professions that relieve suffering.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ardra

input: Ardra nakshatra is connected with hunters, so a vegetarian diet and non-violence are advised.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ardra

input: First pada of Ardra nakshatra gives good effects and truthfulness, while another pada can give ungrateful, mischievous or antisocial traits.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ardra

input: Ascendant in Ardra nakshatra
outcome: intelligent brilliant mind, but crafty speech, fickleness, athletic dexterity and possible ingratitude or deceit.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ardra

input: Moon in Ardra nakshatra
outcome: thirst for knowledge and curious mind, difficult marital karma and delayed marriage.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ardra

input: Sun in Ardra nakshatra
outcome: social skills and political interest, but mental instability, fickleness, criticism, dishonesty, cunning and restlessness.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ardra

input: Ardra nakshatra career indications
outcome: writer, teacher, hospice and social worker, salesperson, public relations, politician, humanitarian, athlete, butcher.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ardra

input: Ardra nakshatra health indications
outcome: nervous system disorders, skin allergies, mental disorders, lung problems.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ardra

input: Punarvasu nakshatra lies in Gemini with its last pada in Cancer and is ruled by Jupiter, with Mercury influence in the first three padas giving intellectual and spiritual wisdom.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Punarvasu

input: Punarvasu nakshatra has power to gain wealth and substance and strong potential in communication fields.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Punarvasu

input: Punarvasu nakshatra is movable (chara) and favours life changes such as career or residence moves; its main motivation is artha.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Punarvasu

input: Punarvasu nakshatra is called the star of renewal, associated with self-purification and personality change, and is one of the most benefic nakshatras.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Punarvasu

input: Shadow side of Punarvasu nakshatra
outcome: over-intellectualising and a critical nature, especially in the first three padas.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Punarvasu

input: Fourth pada of Punarvasu nakshatra (Cancer, 0 to 3 deg 20 min) is vargottama but weakened near the cusp, giving mental vacillation.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Punarvasu

input: Ascendant in Punarvasu nakshatra
outcome: charitable, thoughtful, intelligent, poetic writer, loves freedom, moves often, may have several mates, needs a spiritual partner, acting skill and business success.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Punarvasu

input: Moon in Punarvasu nakshatra
outcome: happy, friendly, contented, good speech and self-control, religious simple life, writing skill, but marital trouble (better for women) and indecision.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Punarvasu

input: Sun in Punarvasu nakshatra
outcome: great intellectual ability, communication gifts, good social status, but emotional overwhelm.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Punarvasu

input: Punarvasu nakshatra career indications
outcome: acting, drama, entertainment, politics, writing, publishing, spiritual teaching, mysticism.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Punarvasu

input: Punarvasu nakshatra health indications
outcome: sensitive nervous system, ear pain or swelling, weak liver and jaundice, lung problems.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Punarvasu

input: Pushya nakshatra lies in Cancer, is ruled by Saturn with Jupiter (Brihaspati) as deity, and Jupiter is exalted there.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Pushya

input: Pushya nakshatra is considered among the most auspicious for spiritual maturity and emphasises worship and spiritual practice.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Pushya

input: Jupiter-Saturn interaction in Pushya nakshatra gives tranquility, self-faith and fullness of life, and increases good karma through discipline.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Pushya

input: Pushya nakshatra is light (laghu) and excellent for starting a business or opening an office.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Pushya

input: Pushya nakshatra is good for starting most endeavours but not for wedding ceremonies.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Pushya

input: Pushya nakshatra's main motivation is dharma and its power is creating spiritual energy.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Pushya

input: Shadow side of Pushya nakshatra
outcome: stubbornness, selfishness, arrogance, pride, jealousy.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Pushya

input: Pushya natives must choose friends carefully, are deflated by criticism, and strong family attachments or insecurity can hinder growth.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Pushya

input: Ascendant in Pushya nakshatra
outcome: humanitarian, thoughtful, eloquent, religious and intuitive, independent, good status, musical or creative gifts, possibly stubborn and bold.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Pushya

input: Moon in Pushya nakshatra
outcome: learned composed mind, virtue, popularity, wealth, political interest, life improves after age 33, problems with family of origin and mother.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Pushya

input: Sun in Pushya nakshatra
outcome: good speech, authority, wealth, thrift, artistic sensitivity, but need for security and possible dictatorial arrogance.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Pushya

input: Pushya nakshatra career indications
outcome: politics, government, geology, aquatic biology, military, police, music, art.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Pushya

input: Pushya nakshatra health indications
outcome: skin problems and eczema, stomach ulcers and nausea, breast cancer, tuberculosis and chest problems.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Pushya

input: Ashlesha nakshatra lies in Cancer, is ruled by Mercury, and the Mercury-Moon mix gives a deep, philosophical, intelligent and penetrating mind.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashlesha

input: Ashlesha nakshatra represents kundalini, which when awakened brings mystical power and enlightenment; main motivation is dharma.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashlesha

input: Ashlesha nakshatra has a poison-like power to harm and is good for creating separation such as divorce or ending a partnership.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashlesha

input: Ashlesha natives are reclusive, austere, self-reliant, magnetic, sensual and seductive.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashlesha

input: Shadow side of Ashlesha nakshatra
outcome: mental instability, worry, fear, melancholy, hot temper, craftiness, lying and self-deception.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashlesha

input: Ashlesha natives cannot tolerate personal humiliation, are psychically vulnerable with a sensitive nervous system, and may struggle to control diet.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashlesha

input: Ascendant in Ashlesha nakshatra
outcome: sensual, seductive, at times cruel or ungrateful, needs tact and time alone, few children, capable of great exertion.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashlesha

input: Moon in Ashlesha nakshatra
outcome: leadership and political success, mystical charm, intuitive and astrological gifts, writing and speaking talent, but diet watch and early marriage struggles.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashlesha

input: Sun in Ashlesha nakshatra
outcome: business oriented, stubborn, opinionated, mystical, good communicator, erratic career.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashlesha

input: Ashlesha nakshatra career indications
outcome: politics, law, writing, teaching, astrology, snake handling, zoo work.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashlesha

input: Ashlesha nakshatra health indications
outcome: food poisoning, obesity, venereal disease, arthritis, nervous disorders.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Ashlesha

input: Magha nakshatra lies in Leo, is ruled by Ketu, and the Sun rules its sign, giving mystical leadership.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Magha

input: Magha nakshatra gives the power to leave the body and make spiritual liberation possible.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Magha

input: Magha nakshatra is protected by the Pitris (ancestors); natives show ambition, leadership, family pride and loyalty to a spiritual lineage.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Magha

input: Magha natives are generous, devoted to loved ones, respect tradition and ritual and are strong performers on life's stage.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Magha

input: Magha nakshatra is fierce (krura or ugra), linked with cruel or harsh activity; its main motivation is artha.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Magha

input: Shadow side of Magha nakshatra
outcome: arrogance, prejudice, class consciousness, attachment to wealth, chronic discontent, approval-seeking and perfectionistic driven pitta personality.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Magha

input: Magha natives are vulnerable to sensual temptations.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Magha

input: Ascendant in Magha nakshatra
outcome: devoted to God and ancestors, wealthy, has servants and receives respect.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Magha

input: Moon in Magha nakshatra
outcome: honoured by learned people, worships gods and ancestors, mystical work, enterprising, charitable, strong but hot-tempered.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Magha

input: Sun in Magha nakshatra
outcome: leadership positions, attention-seeking entertainer, kingly and proud, enjoys travel, connected to a spiritual lineage.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Magha

input: Magha nakshatra career indications
outcome: politics, law, corporate leadership, acting, music, archaeology, history, self-employed management.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Magha

input: Magha nakshatra health indications
outcome: heart problems, stomach ulcers, skin problems near the mouth, hypertension.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Magha

input: Purva Phalguni nakshatra lies in Leo and is ruled by Venus; it gives creative procreative power, great wealth and fine-arts gifts.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Purva Phalguni

input: Purva Phalguni nakshatra's main motivation is kama (healthy enjoyment); natives are youthful, carefree, exuberant, attractive, virile and sweet in dealings.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Purva Phalguni

input: Purva Phalguni nakshatra is less competitive than Magha and tends to give victory over adversaries, with love of music, dance, drama and sociability.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Purva Phalguni

input: Shadow side of Purva Phalguni nakshatra
outcome: vanity, narcissism, indulgence, interest in black magic or left-handed tantra, and fierceness if afflicted.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Purva Phalguni

input: Purva Phalguni natives may crave change, act impulsively, have a disturbed mind, be promiscuous or addictive, and show a showy image.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Purva Phalguni

input: Ascendant in Purva Phalguni nakshatra
outcome: gifts in music, dance and drama, charismatic sensual nature, creative intelligence, good health, interest in leadership or government.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Purva Phalguni

input: Moon in Purva Phalguni nakshatra
outcome: creative intelligence, love of drama, leadership, self-employment, travel, sweet speech, generosity, but disturbed mind and fondness for sex.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Purva Phalguni

input: Sun in Purva Phalguni nakshatra
outcome: performing-arts gifts but vain, humorous, regal, recognition through women, showmanship, athletic, pitta nature.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Purva Phalguni

input: Purva Phalguni nakshatra career indications
outcome: acting, music, modeling, business management, retail, broadcasting, photography, cosmetics, jewelry, wedding planning, government, teaching, marital therapy.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Purva Phalguni

input: Purva Phalguni nakshatra health indications
outcome: skin and lip problems, addiction, heart trouble, circulation problems, venereal disease, fire accidents.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Purva Phalguni

input: Uttara Phalguni nakshatra spans 26 deg 40 min Leo to 10 deg Virgo, is ruled by the Sun, with strong Mercury influence in the last three padas.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Uttara Phalguni

input: First pada of Uttara Phalguni nakshatra (Leo) offers strong growth and creative expansion; the other three padas may reveal yogic powers and deeper mysteries.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Uttara Phalguni

input: Uttara Phalguni nakshatra gives prosperity through marriage or union; Aryaman governs marriage contracts and inheritance and family unity is emphasised.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Uttara Phalguni

input: Uttara Phalguni nakshatra is the star of patronage, giving kindness and compassion; natives are happy, generous, loved and often stable leaders.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Uttara Phalguni

input: Uttara Phalguni natives succeed through education and experience, with courage, endurance, ambition and willingness to fight for righteous causes; main motivation is moksha.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Uttara Phalguni

input: Shadow side of Uttara Phalguni nakshatra
outcome: loneliness without meaningful relationship, co-dependency, over-giving, resentment, ingratitude, stubbornness, critical streak, danger of black magic to control others.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Uttara Phalguni

input: Ascendant in Uttara Phalguni nakshatra
outcome: attractive, wealthy, several mates, generous, proud, intelligent with business talent, skilled hands, humanitarian, intuitive.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Uttara Phalguni

input: Moon in Uttara Phalguni nakshatra
outcome: well liked, successful, stable, respected, inventive, friendly, good for marriage with best marital period ages 38 to 62.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Uttara Phalguni

input: Sun in Uttara Phalguni nakshatra
outcome: humanitarian leadership, love of reading, writing and arts, confident but prone to pride, and a successful retirement.
source: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras | Uttara Phalguni

input: Uttara Phalguni nakshatra career indications

input: Lagna and its lord, the Moon and its sign lord, the 8th house and lord from lagna and from Moon, Saturn and the 8th lord from Saturn, and lagna and hora lagna signs are the pairs whose strength decides longevity.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch6 Nakshatra and longevity

input: Saturn is the basic significator of longevity, Jupiter the general benefactor of longevity, the Sun the soul and vitality karaka and the Moon the karaka of the body.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch6 Nakshatra and longevity

input: Moon rules age 0 to 8, Mercury 8 to 20, Mars 20 to 32, Venus 32 to 45, Jupiter 45 to 60 and Saturn beyond 60.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch6 Nakshatra and longevity

input: For full life, in a pair of signs both movable or one fixed and one dual indicates full life; both dual or one movable and one fixed indicates medium life; both fixed or one movable and one dual indicates short life.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch6 Nakshatra and longevity

input: For broad life span the majority of three pairs (lagna lord and 8th lord, lagna sign and Moon sign, lagna sign and hora lagna sign) decides, and if all differ the lagna and hora lagna pair prevails.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch6 Nakshatra and longevity

input: Moon in lagna or the 7th house
outcome: the lagna sign and Moon sign pair decides the broad life span.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch6 Nakshatra and longevity

input: Unafflicted Jupiter in lagna or the 7th house
outcome: longevity is expected in the last quarter of the broad life group.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch6 Nakshatra and longevity

input: The 12th, 7th and 2nd houses (twelfth from lagna, 3rd and 8th) are maraka houses and the 7th is the most potent maraka.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch6 Nakshatra and longevity

input: Maraka planets can cause death in their dasha or antardasha; Saturn is the general karaka of death; a node associated with a maraka planet becomes maraka.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch6 Nakshatra and longevity

input: Lagna, Moon or a planet placed at the junction (sandhi) of nakshatras in the last or first quarter (gandanta) weakens health and longevity and gives mental worry or phobias.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch6 Nakshatra and longevity

input: Ketu joining a gandanta placement may give brain or spinal disorders and Venus joining may give eye trouble.

input: Gandanta that coincides with a sign junction (Gand Mool) is more severe.

input: Birth in the last quarter of Ashlesha or Jyestha or the first quarter of Moola is Big Moola, and its propitiation is done only after 27 days when the nakshatra recurs.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch6 Nakshatra and longevity

input: Birth in the first quarter of Ashwini or Magha or the last quarter of Revati requires propitiation on the same day, the 10th day or the 19th day.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch6 Nakshatra and longevity

input: Day gandanta

input: Gandanta effects are neutralised when strong unafflicted Jupiter or the lagna lord is in or aspects the lagna or Moon, by birth in Abhijit, or by Mahabhagya or Panch Mahapurusha yoga.

input: Profession is read from the 10th house, its lord, planets in or aspecting it, the navamsha lord of the 10th lord, the lagna lord and the 10th lord in the dashamsha (D-10).
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch7 Profession intro

input: Lords of the nakshatras occupied by key planets, and of the lagna and 10th cusps, modify the significations of those planets and houses.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch7 Profession intro

input: Planets in the 3rd, 6th, 8th or 12th from Indu Lagna indicate unnecessary expenses and losses; strength and benefic influence on Indu Lagna are proportional to financial gain.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch7 Profession intro

input: Indu Lagna (Dhan Lagna) is found by adding the kalas of the 9th lord from lagna and the 9th lord from Moon (Sun 30, Moon 16, Mars 6, Mercury 8, Jupiter 10, Venus 12, Saturn 1), dividing by 12 and counting the remainder from the Moon lagna.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch7 Profession intro

input: A yogakaraka owning both a kendra and a trikona gives greater benefit than other planets for that lagna, and a planet related to it inherits its benefic properties.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch7 Profession intro

input: Only Mars for Cancer and Leo lagna, Venus for Capricorn and Aquarius lagna, and Saturn for Taurus and Libra lagna act as yogakaraka.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch7 Profession intro

input: Yogakaraka dasha is very auspicious even in an evil house and brings career rise, wealth and status; a combust or retrograde yogakaraka delays but still delivers.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch7 Profession intro

input: A yogakaraka from the Moon sign is as important as one from the rising lagna.
source: Raj Kumar, Role of Nakshatra in Astrology | Ch7 Profession intro

input: Fortuna (ascendant plus Moon minus Sun longitude) indicates inherited wealth, worldly fortune and honour, and benefits the house it occupies without affecting character.
